title: All Inclusive-Twilight Ghost Tour with a Boozy Twist
blurb: This is not a pub crawl. It is a fun, entertaining, and engaging ghost tour, including two bar stops, along the tour route. We take great pride in customer service. We limited the number of people on this tour, so that we can provide the best experience possible. In this experience, we are providing one complimentary drink, at each of the two bar stops. Note: you will be given a special menu, which will include wells, select wines, and drafts. We ask that you don’t order an additional drink, or order anything outside of the special menu. Please do not order food or appetizers. Please do not arrive on the tour inebriated or under the influence of a substance. Due to the liability risk, you will not be allowed to participate in tour experience. Please use common sense. Note: You will not receive a refund, if you violate this policy. We only allow 12 people on each tour, so this tour tends to sell out quickly.
